aboutText: Melbourne Drains has been serving the Craigieburn community for over 15 years, specialising in all drainage and plumbing needs. Whether it's a blocked drain at midnight or a burst pipe causing flooding, our licensed team arrives quickly to resolve the problem without fuss. We pride ourselves on transparent pricing, same-day service, and a 100% workmanship guarantee. Available 24/7, we handle everything from leak detection to pipe relining with proven expertise.
servicesText: Melbourne Drains offers a wide range of services including blocked drains, pipe relining, burst pipes, tap repairs, leak detection, and general plumbing. With 24/7 emergency response and a 30-minute arrival time, we ensure fast and reliable solutions for all your drainage issues.

services.title: Blocked Drains
services.desc: We quickly clear blocked drains using professional equipment, diagnosing the issue to prevent future blockages.

services.title: Pipe Relining
services.desc: Our pipe relining service repairs damaged pipes without excavation, providing a long-lasting solution for cracked or collapsed drains.

services.title: Burst Pipes
services.desc: For burst pipes causing water damage, our team responds fast to stop the leak and repair or replace the pipe.

services.title: Tap Repairs
services.desc: We fix dripping or faulty taps efficiently, ensuring proper function and water conservation in your home.

services.title: Leak Detection
services.desc: Using advanced technology, we detect hidden leaks in walls or underground, minimising damage and repair costs.

services.title: General Plumbing
services.desc: From toilet repairs to hot water systems, we handle all general plumbing tasks with licensed and insured professionals.
